title: F. Michael Watson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth
Married Jolene Mann, September 3, 1965, Salt Lake Temple; twelve children.
U.S. Army 1966-69, including Vietnam. Bronze Star and Army Commendation Medal
Bachelor of Science degree in business/office administration; Utah State University in 1970.
Assistant Secretary to the Twelve; Secretary to the Twelve; Assistant Secretary to the First Presidency; Secretary to the First Presidency.
Elders Quorum President, Bishop, Stake President, and Sealer in the Bountiful Utah Temple
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
